title: The European Commission has closed a loophole in the import quotas for rebar
content:
The European Commission has published an implementing regulation clarifying the classification of fittings under the current steel safeguard regime. This is stated in a press release from the institution. title: Australia’s coking coal exports fell by 2% y/y in Q1
content:
In January–March 2026, Australia reduced its coking coal exports by 2% year-on-year – to approximately 33.38 million tons, according to data from BigMint.
